messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air given temperature and volume. They have three experiments:

1. Volume 2.5 m^3, temperature 300 K (but they wrote 300°C? Actually they said "保持溫度在300開氏度" which means 300 degrees Celsius? But then they say "更高的溫度350開氏度". So they might mean 300°C and 350°C. But the function expects temperature in Kelvin. So we need to convert Celsius to Kelvin: T(K) = T(°C)+273.15. So 300°C = 573.15 K. 350°C = 623.15 K.

But the user says "我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度" - maybe they mean 300 K? But they used "開氏度" which is Celsius. But they also mention "更高的溫度350開氏度". So likely they want 300°C and 350°C. Then next experiment: lower volume 1.5 m^3 at same temperatures? They say "在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" meaning they will repeat the experiment at lower volume 1.5 m^3 at both temperatures? Or just one temperature? They say "在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" after describing the two temperatures. So likely they will do the same experiment at 1.5 m^3 at both temperatures. So total experiments: 3 conditions: (2.5 m^3, 300°C), (2.5 m^3, 350°C), (1.5 m^3, 300°C). Wait they didn't mention 1.5 m^3 at 350°C? They said "在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" meaning they will repeat the experiment at lower volume. That could mean they will repeat the same temperature conditions at lower volume. So yes, 1.5 m^3 at 300°C and 350°C. So total 4 experiments: 2 volumes x 2 temperatures. But the user asked "你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？" meaning "Can you provide the heat capacities for these three different conditions?" So maybe they only want 3 conditions: (2.5 m^3, 300°C), (2.5 m^3, 350°C), (1.5 m^3, 300°C). They omitted 1.5 m^3 at 350°C. So we should ask clarification. But we can interpret as they want 3 conditions: 2.5 m^3 at 300°C, 2.5 m^3 at 350°C, 1.5 m^3 at 300°C. We can compute each using the function. The function signature: temp in Kelvin, volume in m^3, gas optional. We'll call it thrice. Let's do that.
